# Milestone 6 (part): the prior chosen per kind without the rotated item (generated by run.py)

227 groups, 13 leave-one-item-out folds. KSEL = per kind, the prior (P0, COL, ADD, LR) with the smallest leave-one-cell-out squared error on the other 12 items, column of the held-out item deleted. Ratios are mean group MSE over the reference's; item-cluster bootstrap 95% in brackets.

## Prediction checks (LOG.md, 2026-11-16)

1. period picks COL or ADD in at least 12 of 13: {'COL': 13}
2. generation picks P0 in at least 11 of 13: {'P0': 12, 'LR': 1}
3. tradition picks ADD in at least 9 of 13: {'ADD': 12, 'LR': 1}
4. KSEL at 50 at most 0.70 of P0 and at most ADD (0.725): 0.826; at 400 at most 1.03: 1.045
5. without same-sex marriage, KSEL at 50 at most 0.95 of P0: 0.863
6. KSEL robust coverage at least 94% at every n&#772;: 97.3%, 95.2%, 93.9%, 94.3%
Refutation (KSEL not at most 0.95 of P0 at 50): 0.826
